name: Sunhe Energy
name_zh: 深圳市三和朝阳科技有限公司
summary: Shenzhen Sunhe Energy Co., Ltd. develops and supplies custom lithium battery cells and packs. Its robot-battery catalog lists cylindrical 18650 pack configurations. Six configurations have consistent source identity; three others remain unresolved because of conflicting model or manufacturer labels. The company identifies a Shenzhen headquarters and R&D base and a separate production base in Hubei.
